Nine hundred hours in, and I’m still coming back for more. Dead by Daylight is one of the most unique multiplayer games out there: a tense 4v1 game of cat and mouse where every match plays out differently. Whether you’re a survivor sweating through a last generator or a killer hunting down the final survivor, the adrenaline never gets old.

What it does best:

Two completely different experiences. Survivor is all stealth, teamwork, and clutch escapes. Killer is about pressure, mind games, and map control. Switching sides keeps the game fresh.
Huge variety. With dozens of killers, survivors, perks, add-ons, and maps, there’s always a new build to try. No two trials feel quite the same.
Licensed chapters. Horror icons and original characters sit side by side, and each new chapter brings new powers, perks, and playstyles.
Skill ceiling. Looping, mind-gaming, tracking, and macro decisions take real time to master. After hundreds of hours I’m still learning new tricks.
Best with friends. A coordinated survivor squad or a good group in voice chat is where the game really shines.

What could be better:

Matchmaking and balance can be hit or miss, and some matches just aren’t fun.
The learning curve is steep for new players, and the first few hours can be rough.
Some DLC and cosmetics are pricey, though the game is fully playable without all of them.
Toxic players exist, as in most competitive games.

Dead by Daylight isn’t perfect, but it delivers something no other game quite matches. The thrill of a close escape, or of a hard-earned 4k, is why I’ve sunk this much time into it. If you like horror, tension, and a challenge that keeps rewarding you the more you learn, give it a try. Just don’t be surprised when you look up and see your playtime in the hundreds.

当你买下这款游戏并且游玩两小时：恭喜你！你染上粪坑了！
这是一款：
游戏体验堪比大分，却让你越吃越想吃
人小子屠小子遍地，社区粪围极好
“开挂最少，绿玩地位最高”
”最不功利，最不嘲讽，最不时长歧视”
的游戏。

当你染上这款游戏，你将会度过一段相对失败的人生。
你将无喜无悲。（因为你将一直红温）
你将无殇无悦。（因为你将一直麻木）
你将告别你的素质。
你将告别你的愉悦。
当你下班，打开这款游戏，你会看到：
“3000小时都没到，有什么资格评价这款游戏？”
“你打不赢就是菜，被我鞭尸闪手电都是应该的”（当你选择玩下水道屠夫，胜负就已经和你没有关系；当你选择玩单排，你将得到在你溜鬼时逛街的神人队友）
“这是战术嘲讽”
“不开找自己问题”
“ez,noob”（你好心给这人放地窖）
致敬玩家素质最高，魔怔b最少的游戏。
但是不得不说，联动皮肤是真的多，大部分经典ip都有。可能这也是为什么这烂游戏会活到现在吧。

单排人类近500小时，可能就是单纯享受游戏，能跑就跑，但是对待每场对局都很认真，段位看起来没有意义，好像是隐藏分区分实力。有时候匹100小时有时候匹3000小时，很难做到势均力敌，总会有碾压的一方。单排人类体验尤为糟糕，很容易红温，但正如上文所言，我本人玩游戏不太功利，红温的同时还是能享受游戏的乐趣的。虽然找不回初次游玩时心惊胆战的感觉了，但博弈成功，甚至溜五台的乐趣却历久弥新。游戏是好游戏，但总会有不完美的地方，bug有，挂也有，但毕竟是十年的老游戏，而且禁外挂哪个游戏能做到杜绝呢。总而言之，普通玩家把这个当成竞技游戏本身就不合适，因为平衡性很难做到绝对公平。最后的最后，我由衷希望黎明杀机发展更好。
